definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when meeting someone for the first time.
Used when asking someone to handle something or requesting their favorable consideration.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めまして。{田中|たなか}です。どうぞよろしく。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. I'm Tanaka. Pleased to meet you.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}から{一緒|いっしょ}に{働|はたら}きます。どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'll be working with you starting today. Pleased to meet you.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}の{山田|やまだ}です。どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'm Yamada, the new employee. I look forward to working with you.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{隣|となり}の{部署|ぶしょ}に{異動|いどう}になります。どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I'll be transferring to the neighboring department next month. I look forward to your kind support.

examples.japanese: この{件|けん}、どうぞよろしく。
examples.english: Please take care of this matter.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}の{準備|じゅんび}、どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please take care of the preparations for tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}の{確認|かくにん}、どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please take care of checking the documents.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がお{世話|せわ}になります。どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: My child will be in your care. Thank you in advance.

examples.japanese: {今後|こんご}とも{変|か}わらぬお{付|つ}き{合|あ}いのほど、どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I humbly ask for your continued association going forward.

notes:
USAGE: どうぞよろしく is the shortened form of どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします. It's used:
1. When meeting someone for the first time
2. When asking for someone's help or cooperation
3. At the end of self-introductions

FORMALITY LEVELS:
・よろしく (casual)
・どうぞよろしく (polite)
・どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします (formal)
・どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いいたします (very formal)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・Self-introductions
・Business meetings
・Email endings
・Requesting favors
